name: Midtown
description: A compact downtown district on an ordinary weekday morning.

transit_plaza.name: Transit Plaza
transit_plaza.description: Commuters cross an open plaza between the station entrance, a small café, and a public-library branch. Electronic boards quietly list arrivals and departures.

corner_cafe.name: Corner Café
corner_cafe.description: A bright neighborhood café with a long counter, a few occupied tables, and the calm hiss of an espresso machine.

library_walk.name: Library Walk
library_walk.description: A tree-lined pedestrian path runs along the library’s glass façade. A bench faces a modest community noticeboard.

library_lobby.name: Library Lobby
library_lobby.description: The public library lobby is quiet and welcoming, with returns slots, event posters, and a self-service checkout kiosk.

station_concourse.name: Station Concourse
station_concourse.description: The station concourse is clean, busy, and lined with ticket machines. A departure board glows above the platforms.
